pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.description: Choose the plan that works best for you. Start free, upgrade when you need more.
pricing.freeDescription: Perfect for trying out IG Export
pricing.lifetimeDescription: Best value - pay once, use forever
pricing.faq1Answer: Each Instagram profile (follower, following, or user) you export counts as one record. For example, exporting 500 followers = 500 records.
pricing.faq2Question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing.faq2Answer: Yes! You can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
pricing.faq3Answer: Absolutely. IG Export is a local-first extension - all data processing happens in your browser. We never store your Instagram credentials or exported data on our servers.
pricing.faq4Answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. If you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.

billing.freeDescription: Up to 100 records per collection, with CSV and JSON export. No license key required.
billing.activationDescription: After successful payment, copy your license key from the Dodo Payments email. Open the extension → License & plans → paste your key → Activate license. Deactivate this browser before moving the key to another device.
billing.renewalDescription: Monthly, quarterly and yearly plans renew at their selected interval. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Manage your subscription through the customer portal link in your Dodo Payments email. License validity follows the payment and subscription status.
billing.limitsNote: An internet connection is required to verify Pro access. Instagram availability and rate limits apply to every plan. Supported formats vary between the popup and workspace; Excel export is .xls, not .xlsx.
billing.delivery: Your payment has been confirmed by Dodo Payments. Your license key will be delivered to your checkout email.
billing.statusNote: A return to this page does not activate Pro. Check your receipt email or check the payment status again.
billing.stepEmail: Find the license key in your Dodo Payments email.
billing.stepOpen: Open IG Export and select License & plans.
billing.stepActivate: Paste the key and click Activate license.
billing.emailDelay: Email delivery can take a few minutes. Check spam folders. If your receipt arrives without a key, contact support with the payment reference; do not post your key publicly.
